title: Schedule of Repayment Plan and Reduced Withholding Terms by Debt Type — Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery
content:
The figures below govern installment repayment and reduced monthly withholding on debts in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery**, by debt type.

| Debt type | Smallest plan installment (USD a month) | Smallest reduced withholding (USD a month) | Longest plan without a Financial Status Report (months) | Longest plan with a Financial Status Report (months) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Education Overpayment (Chapters 30, 35 and 1606) | 25.00 | 25.00 | 12 | 60 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Housing and Books Overpayment | 25.00 | 25.00 | 12 | 60 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Tuition and Fees Overpayment | 25.00 | 25.00 | 12 | 60 |
| Disability Compensation Overpayment | 25.00 | 25.00 | 12 | 60 |
| Veterans Pension Overpayment | 25.00 | 25.00 | 12 | 60 |
| Home Loan Guaranty Debt | 50.00 | 50.00 | 12 | 60 |

| Debt type | First installment due after approval (calendar days) | Consecutive missed installments that cancel a plan | Reduced withholding requires a Financial Status Report | Rounding of a computed monthly installment | Direct payment channels |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Education Overpayment (Chapters 30, 35 and 1606) | 30 | 2 | Yes | Up to the next cent | Pay.gov, phone, mail |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Housing and Books Overpayment | 30 | 2 | Yes | Up to the next cent | Pay.gov, phone, mail |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Tuition and Fees Overpayment | 30 | 2 | Yes | Up to the next cent | Pay.gov, phone, mail |
| Disability Compensation Overpayment | 30 | 2 | Yes | Up to the next cent | Pay.gov, phone, mail |
| Veterans Pension Overpayment | 30 | 2 | Yes | Up to the next cent | Pay.gov, phone, mail |
| Home Loan Guaranty Debt | 30 | 2 | Yes | Up to the next cent | Pay.gov, phone, mail |

## Terms used in the schedule

- **Smallest plan installment** — the smallest monthly installment accepted for a repayment plan.
- **Smallest reduced withholding** — the smallest monthly reduced withholding VA approves on hardship.
- **Longest plan without / with a Financial Status Report** — the longest repayment plan approved without, and with, a Financial Status Report.
- **First installment due** — the days after plan approval by which the first installment is due.
- **Consecutive missed installments** — the number of consecutive missed installments that cancels a repayment plan.
- **Rounding** — a computed monthly installment is rounded up to the cent: any fraction of a cent raises the figure to the next whole cent.

## Notes on the schedule

**Is the Home Loan Guaranty Debt different?** Yes, in its money floors only: its smallest plan installment and smallest reduced withholding are each 50.00 USD a month, against 25.00 USD for the other five types. Its plan lengths, due days and default count match the others.

**Hypothetical rounding illustration.** A computed monthly figure of 83.3333 USD is rounded up to 83.34 USD; a computed figure of exactly 83.30 USD stays 83.30 USD.
